purpose: Reviewable configuration proposal; not a preregistration or an executed run
seed_derivation: SHA256 of rp002a/proposal-0.1/world/replicate/split/purpose, first 64 bits as unsigned integer; no seed reuse across tuples

B2.model: single GRU and categorical linear head
B2.bias_convention: two bias vectors per GRU gate

B3.model: exact Bayes filter conditional on observed history

primary_metric: episode-mean natural-log loss, equally weighted across independent replicates
interval_method: paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap: resample replicate indices, then held-out episodes within selected replicate; retain pairing across models
decisions: E1 benefit requires entire adjusted interval for alternative-minus-reference below -0.01; equivalence requires entire adjusted interval within [-0.01, 0.01]; otherwise indeterminate. No p-value-only equivalence claims.
failures: Retain every failed run; no discretionary retries, model substitution or seed replacement. A failed model in any replicate makes the planned complete-case comparison indeterminate until a separately versioned deviation is reviewed.
limitations: Only one proposed parameter setting per world
Five replicates give limited uncertainty resolution
Model sizes are approximately matched, not identical
Hardware/environment lock and collision assessment remain pending
